raw_text: After breakfast I saw Sarah emailed me that the workshop has moved to 2pm. It was a quiet afternoon. Later I realized Jake heard the room number changed to 2B, and I told Sarah to confirm it.

After lunch, Sam noticed Mochi the cat scratching my notes and reminded me to reschedule with Dr. Nguyen. At 6:30 Sarah asked me if Dr. Nguyen could reschedule the appointment for next week, and I promised to follow up. The rain stopped suddenly. Later, Dr. Nguyen visited my apartment with Emily, and I noticed the draft on my desk looked better.

After breakfast, I texted Lina that the landlord approved the lease. At noon, Miso barked loudly, and I noticed Omar waving from across the street. I wondered whether the rent would rise, and the email from Lina reassured me it wouldn't. Later, I double-checked the paperwork and saved the PDF to my laptop. That evening, I saw the landlord's sign still on the door, and I smiled.
After dinner, I wondered whether Sarah noticed Jake cancelled my flight to Lisbon, and I texted him the updated itinerary for 7:30pm.

At 7:30am I walked to Mina's café and my dog, Luna, greeted Dr. Rao outside. When the delivery arrived, Dr. Rao said he had left a note saying the package was for Carlos, and I saw it on the doorstep. Later, I thought the note might be meant for the wrong apartment, because my neighbor Aisha heard Luna barking and noticed Carlos's name in the handwriting. Tomorrow morning I will call the courier company, cancel the redelivery request, and check the tracking number at 9am.
Before noon, I realized Maria had scheduled the dentist appointment for Thursday, and I heard my cat Luna meow at the door, so I promised Jake I'd bring the keys.

After lunch Amina heard the assistant mention room 204, then noticed the schedule had shifted to 4pm. I called it a relief and decided to send the revised timeline to Carlos. Later Dr. Chen agreed that we should submit the report by Friday. When the call ended, Milo jumped onto the desk and knocked over the notes. In the evening I realized I had never backed up the files before midnight. I promised myself to do it again tomorrow morning. Finally I thought the day made me calmer, even though the deadline felt tight.
